en.headline: One Stanley seller says it will cooperate with probe
en.dek: K Wise Limited said late on Saturday it would remedy the Stanley house if the inquiry finds fault, citing the department's view of no obvious danger.
body: The seller of One Stanley said late on Saturday it would cooperate with a Buildings Department investigation into reinforcement that does not match approved plans at a house in the Stanley development.

K Wise Limited, a subsidiary of K&K Property and the seller of the project, said in a statement that it took the matter seriously. It said it was checking records with relevant professionals and would assist the department. If the inquiry found fault in workmanship or related matters, the company said it would remedy the affected property under the applicable rules and pursue those responsible.

The Buildings Department said on Saturday that a wire mesh was missing from the cover of a beam on a lower ground floor, and that reinforcement in some floor slabs did not follow the drawings. It said the overall structure showed no obvious danger. The department has asked the developer and contractors for information and is still investigating.

zh.headline: One Stanley賣方稱配合屋宇署調查
zh.dek: 建灝附屬公司堅維有限公司周六深夜發聲明，指會核實資料並協助署方，若查實有失誤會補救及追究責任。
body: 赤柱豪宅One Stanley一間獨立屋的賣方表示，會配合屋宇署就鋼筋配置與圖則不符展開的調查。
建灝地產附屬公司、項目賣方堅維有限公司周六深夜發聲明，稱高度重視事件並會嚴肅跟進。公司表示正與相關專業人士核實資料，並會盡力配合署方。聲明說，若調查發現有人在施工質量或相關事項上有失誤，會按相關法例向受影響物業補救，並追究責任。
屋宇署周六表示，該獨立屋地面低層一條橫樑保護層沒有按圖則配置鋼絲網，部分樓板鋼筋亦與圖則不符，但整體結構未見明顯危險。署方已要求發展商及承建商提供資料，調查仍在進行。
